children: Micron Technology Inc. (MU, Financials) was up more than 6% , completing the day at $1,016.59.

Some of the rise was on a favorable day for chip stocks. AMD rose over 5 percent and Taiwan Semiconductor also gained ground. But Micron has something investors want now: memory for artificial intelligence systems.
The massive servers being created for AI need high-bandwidth memory in massive quantities. And still, there's not enough of it for the time being. This has put Micron in a nice spot:
With firms spending billions on developing AI data centers, Micron finds another user for the memory sitting next to those expensive processors. But there is a catch.
Memory has its booms and busts, as we all know. When prices are high companies build capacity, supply catches up and profits can disappear fast.
That cycle has not disappeared. Micron investors are merely banking that AI demand can keep it at bay a little longer.
We will see if that bet is paying off in the upcoming earnings report, particularly in terms of HBM demand, memory costs and margins.

title: Micron Jumps 6% as AI Memory Trade Keeps Running
